_comment: crew — GLOBAL web-Dock config (~/.config/cmux/dock.json), rendered by
`crew apply`. Only workspace-agnostic controls: the board, the usage
dashboard, and the Sessions finder and the Sweep, which look machine-wide
whatever their cwd. A terminal control's relative cwd resolves from the
config base — $HOME here — so the git/checks/spec loops live in each
repo's .cmux/dock.json, where cwd '.' means the repo. A repo config
replaces this one wholesale (precedence, not merge), which is why the
project template carries these controls as well.
The board page is inert until crew-listen pushes the renderer into it;
crew-board adopts the seeded surface instead of creating its own.
__INTENT_PORT__ must match the intent server's pin (CREW_INTENT_PORT,
